headline: Claim Drew Lock (bid 7, drop Malik Willis) before Wed 12:05 AM PT — he's confirmed Seattle's starter with Darnold out and fixes your week 6 Burrow/Willis bye clash.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and healthy at the top of his lineup; the only open call is upgrading a thin FLEX spot and locking down a real QB3 before Wednesday's waiver run. MarShawn Lloyd cleared and is Green Bay's workhorse with Jacobs out indefinitely, so he swaps in for Tre Tucker, whose route/snap lead hasn't translated to targets.

lineup.why: Lloyd is projected for 13+ touches as GB's clear early-down back in a favored, high-total game, while Tucker managed only 4 targets in Week 1 and Las Vegas is a 7-point road underdog.
lineup.evidence: Lloyd: room shows him RB1 with Jacobs still on the exempt list (NA/Personal) and Chris Brooks the only real backup; reporting from this week confirms Lloyd is handling a workhorse role in Jacobs' absence. Tucker: led Raiders WRs in snaps/routes Week 1 but drew just 4 targets as the offense ran through RB Ashton Jeanty with Bowers out; this week Las Vegas is a 7-point underdog with a 18.3 implied total.

adds.why: tier 2, bid 7 of your 145: a confirmed but short-term starting QB, priced to the gap, and it also fixes the week 6 Burrow/Willis bye clash since Seattle's bye is week 11.
adds.evidence: Sleeper still tags Lock QB2/'not the starter' behind Darnold, but Darnold's hip injury is expected to keep him out this week and Seattle's coach has said he expects Lock to start at Arizona; Lock already started and won Week 1 for Seattle. Willis is Miami's own starter (room shows him QB1) but shares Burrow's week 6 bye, which is the specific hole being filled, and Miami is a 12.5-point underdog this week.

flags.what: on IR, ankle sprain (flagged since last week, no change)
RB2/change-of-pace behind Bucky Irving in Tampa Bay (Sep 13-15 reporting: out-targeted 7-1 by Irving in Week 1, a 1B role not a starting job)

watch.what: Thursday 5:15 PM PT kickoff vs DET is this week's earliest lock; real slot role (6 targets Week 1) in a great spot (favored 4.5, implied 29), but thinner projected volume (5.8 targets) than Lloyd — only a lineup candidate if Danny wants a second FLEX change before Thursday.

alerts.title: ➕ Claim Drew Lock, drop Willis
alerts.body: Lock is Seattle's confirmed Week 2 starter (Darnold out, hip) and fixes your week 6 Burrow/Willis bye clash. Bid 7, drop Willis, claim processes Wed 12:05 AM PT.

alerts.title: 🔁 Start Lloyd over Tucker
alerts.body: MarShawn Lloyd cleared and is Green Bay's workhorse back with Jacobs still on the exempt list. Swap him in for Tre Tucker (LV) before Sunday 10:00 AM PT kickoffs.
